question: Motion to Invoke Cloture: Motion to Proceed to H.R. 6500 — A bill to extend duty-free treatment provided with respect to imports from certain countries in Africa under the African Growth and Opportunity Act, to extend customs user fees, and for other purposes.
result: Cloture on the Motion to Proceed Agreed to (89-4, 3/5 majority required)
plain_language: This was a vote to end debate on starting consideration of H.R. 6500 as it then stood: an extension of duty-free treatment for certain African imports and of customs user fees. A Yea moves the Senate toward taking up that bill. A Nay blocks ending debate.
